content.title: Coachella 2026: Tickets, Dates & Everything You Need to Know
content.text: Photograph: Courtesy Christopher Polk/Getty Images for CoachellaCoachella 2026: a complete guide including tickets, dates and locationGet your Coachella festival 2026 info here, including dates and when you can expect the lineupSaturday April 11 2026Ready or not, Coachella 2026 is finally here. The Indio music festival typically marks one of the earliest live music weekends across the country (and maybe we’re a bit biased, but we’d say its lineup outclasses nearly every other music festival, too). The 2026 edition will inevitably bring with it plenty of bands and DJs to see and amazing things to eat and drink between sets (spoiler: food from some of the best restaurants in Los Angeles). Here’s what you need to know. What is Coachella? The Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival is an annual music festival held over two weekends in Indio, just east of Palm Springs. When is Coachella? The festival is held over two weekends, April 10–12 and April 17–19, 2026. Where is Coachella? Not in the city of Coachella, surprisingly. Though most of us simply refer to the fest as Coachella, it’s technically the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival. So the event actually takes place at the Empire Polo Club, a large field in the city of Indio (which is part of the larger Coachella Valley, a desert area a couple of hours east of L.A. in Riverside County). When did Coachella tickets go on sale? Tickets for the 2026 fest went on sale Friday, September 19 at 11am (2024 and 2025 attendees and American Express card members were also able to access them a day earlier). The festival announced that passes had sold out by the following Monday—a notable change after a few years of not selling out. How much are Coachella tickets? We hope you’ve been saving up (all of the following prices include fees): General admission started at $649 for weekend one and $549 for weekend two. Shuttle combo tickets cost $779 for the first weekend and $679 for the second. For VIP, it cost $1,299 for weekend one and $1,199 for weekend two. (All of these prices tend to increase by at least $50 if you’re not among the first to grab tickets.) Check out the Coachella website for a wide range of camping rates, as well as info on the payment plan. What does the Coachella lineup look like? Though the lineup usually didn’t come along until January for years, the latest roster arrived earlier than ever, way back in September: Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G and Anyma will headline 2026’s edition of the fest. The XX, the Strokes, Addison Rae, Young Thug, KATSEYE and BIGBANG are among the fest’s sub-headliners—plus the last-minute addition of Jack White. Will Coachella be live streamed? YouTube will once again return as the exclusive live stream partner for the 2026 festival.You’ll be able to watch streams from seven stages, including a multiview feature that shows four stages at once. Streams typically rerun once between days of the fest, and after that you’ll only find brief clips of performances on the official Coachella channel. Need a place to stay?
